# Part VI. Integrative Negotiation {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-note .part-overview icon=false}
## Why this part comes here

Compromise divides the obvious pie. Integration asks whether the pie was defined too narrowly. Multiple issues, different priorities, different forecasts, and different risk tolerances create opportunities—but only if the process reveals them safely.
:::

## Guiding questions

- What interest sits behind each stated position?
- Which differences can create value?
- How can offers reveal priorities without unnecessary exposure?
- What uncertainty should be resolved now, and what can be written into the agreement?

## Bridge to the next part

Negotiation exposes a deeper requirement: two hidden inner worlds must become mutually understandable. Part VII therefore turns from bargaining to communication and connection.
